title: ixora carnea
intro: Ixora carnea, commonly known as the jungle geranium, is a plant species belonging to the Rubiaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The health benefits of Ixora carnea include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as pain relief and immune system support. The bioactive constituents of Ixora carnea include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
